items.proposed: drop the EGFR_EGFRvIII row (not an entry requirement); no candidate match either way
items.reason: EGFR appears only in label-indication wording for the brain-metastasis pembrolizumab arm ('NSCLC expressing PD-L1, with no EGFR or ALK genomic tumor aberrations' and 'EGFR or ALK genomic tumor aberrations must have disease progression'), so both EGFR states are allowed and it is not a selection requirement. No effect on the primary outcome (not candidate-matched) and any_molecular_selection stays true via PD-L1/MSI-H arm requirements.

Follows the proposed regimen 'monotherapy' for the GBM-eligible arms ('Patients receiving NEO212 alone for treatment of Astrocytoma IDH-mutant and Glioblastoma IDH-wildtype'); the SOC partners are given only in brain-metastasis arms. If XL prefers whole-trial coding, use coder B's list.

GBM patients receive 'NEO212 alone' (Phase 1 and Phase 2b glioma arm); combination arms enrol only brain metastases from other solid tumours. The manual does not say how to code regimen when arms differ; proposing GBM-eligible arms for consistency with NCT05599984, where both coders did so.

note: Needs an XL convention for trial-level regimen when GBM-eligible arms are monotherapy but other (non-GBM) arms are combinations. Coder A also listed aflibercept from 'FOLFIRI Protocol (other names: Zaltrap)' (priority 3); the record's FOLFIRI description lists only folinic acid, fluorouracil and irinotecan, so aflibercept is probably a mislabel.
